title: Rice

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Rice
source.note: Chuyển thể sang mức A1 (câu ngắn, từ đơn giản); thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: Rice is a kind of food. It is the main food in many parts of Asia. Rice grows in warm parts of the world.

Farmers plant rice in flat fields full of water. People usually cook rice. In India, people eat rice with sauce, curry or soup. In Spain, people first fry rice in oil or butter. Then they cook it with water or soup.
People think that rice first grew in southern China and India. That was more than 4,000 years ago. From India, rice went to Europe and Africa.

options: In warm parts of the world
In cold places with no water
Only in the sea or in rivers
